description: How a token's supply is spread over its holders: share held by the top 10, 50 and 100 holders, holders by size, the rest of the supply, balances sitting in DEX pools and contracts. `coverage` says exactly what the list is: the largest balances of a complete read, or only the largest among the addresses read before the read stopped (then no "top N" share is given, and the holder count is a lower bound). Never quote a share as "top N" when `coverage.listIsTop` is false.

unit.description: Token unit: 56-hex policy id followed by the asset name in hex (no separator). Get it from `search` or `list_tokens`.
